description: This file defines the Attributes interface which models a set of static, detailed properties associated with entities such as 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for building, modifying, and converting attribute collections to JSON.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of static attributes associated with entities, providing methods for creation, modification, and JSON conversion.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing Attributes instances.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mutable builder initialized with the current Attributes instance for modifications.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the Attributes collection, with overloads for various data types.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField in the Attributes collection.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonFields to the Attributes collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the Attributes collection.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Attributes collection to a JsonObject respecting schema version and field selection.
